idea: Custom printed T-shirts and hoodies for college fests and clubs

strategist.problem: A fest committee or club head needs 100-300 custom T-shirts/hoodies in 10-14 days before the event and gets stuck juggling unresponsive local printers, unclear per-piece pricing, and no proof of print quality before paying 50% advance.
strategist.target_customer: College fest committees and club heads in Indian cities with 3,000+ students, ordering 100+ pieces per event with a sanctioned budget, who currently WhatsApp random local printers and need a reliable quote and sample before the event date.
strategist.mission: Deliver event-ready custom T-shirts and hoodies to Indian college clubs and fests on a fixed date with transparent per-piece pricing and a print proof before advance payment.

competitors.name: Local screen-printing shops near campus
competitors.differentiator: We give a fixed quote, digital print proof and a committed delivery date in writing, which walk-in printers rarely commit to.

competitors.name: Print-on-demand platforms like PrintShop/Inkmonk-style online custom apparel sites
competitors.differentiator: We beat them on bulk per-piece price for 100+ units and offer campus pickup instead of courier delays.

competitors.name: Freelance merch resellers on Fiverr or Instagram
competitors.differentiator: We show real past campus orders and take UPI payment links with 50% advance tracked in one place, not scattered DMs.

scope_cuts: Skip building a custom design tool or 3D shirt previewer; use Canva templates and a static proof image sent on WhatsApp instead.
Skip running our own printing press; partner with one existing local screen printer for the first 20 orders before investing in equipment.
Skip a mobile app or website storefront; take orders through an Instagram profile and a Google Form until the sixth paying customer.

stack.name: Instagram
stack.why: Primary storefront to display past campus prints and capture orders via DMs without a website.

stack.name: WhatsApp Business
stack.why: Manage 50% advance payments, share digital print proofs, and coordinate delivery with club heads.

stack.name: Razorpay
stack.why: Generate secure UPI payment links for 50% advance deposits from college committees.

stack.name: Google Forms
stack.why: Collect bulk order details like quantities, sizes, and design files from fest committees.

stack.name: Canva
stack.why: Create digital print proofs and simple order confirmation documents for customers.

ai_tools.name: ChatGPT
ai_tools.why: Draft WhatsApp templates for quotes, advance payment requests, and delivery updates.

ai_tools.name: Claude
ai_tools.why: Generate detailed supplier comparison sheets and draft terms of service for bulk orders.

mvp_features: Custom screen-printed 180 GSM cotton T-shirts in 3 standard colors (black, white, navy) with 1-color or 2-color front prints.
Custom screen-printed 300 GSM fleece hoodies in black with 1-color front and back prints for winter fest events.
Digital print proof service where the customer approves a Canva-generated image on WhatsApp before paying the 50% advance.

tool_costs.price_note: 2% + GST per payment, no setup fee or AMC. Price checked 2026-11-02 on https://razorpay.com/pricing/

first_10_steps: Visit 3 local screen-printing shops near campus and negotiate bulk rates for 100-300 units of 180 GSM T-shirts and 300 GSM hoodies.
Order 5 sample T-shirts and 3 sample hoodies from the best-priced shop to verify print quality and fabric weight.
Create an Instagram Business profile and post 3 photos of the sample prints with clear per-piece pricing for 100+ units.
Set up a Google Form to collect order details including quantity, size breakdown, design file, and event date.
Generate a Razorpay payment link for a 50% advance deposit and test it with a batchmate to ensure UPI works.
Share the Instagram profile and Google Form link in 5 college club WhatsApp groups and 2 hostel group chats.
Send a digital print proof via WhatsApp to the first 3 interested club heads and ask for their written approval.
Collect the 50% advance payment via Razorpay link from the first approved club head to secure the order.
Place the bulk order with the local printer using the approved design and confirm the delivery date in writing.
Deliver the finished T-shirts and hoodies to the club head on the committed date and request a photo of the event for Instagram.

pricing.name: Club Tee Pack (100+ pieces)
features: 100 pieces 180 GSM T-shirts, 1-color front print, ₹340 per piece
Digital print proof approved on WhatsApp before 50% advance
Delivery to campus on committed event date

pricing.name: Fest Hoodie Pack (100+ pieces)
features: 100 pieces 300 GSM hoodies, 1-color front and back print, ₹690 per piece
Digital print proof and size breakdown sheet
50% advance via Razorpay UPI link, balance on delivery

burn_line_items.item: Razorpay Standard (per-transaction fees excluded, billed on settlement)
Marketing budget (₹200 Instagram boosts x 5 + ₹1000 sample/print collateral)

revenue_targets.notes: First fest committee order booked with 50% advance collected via Razorpay link.
Second club order plus one repeat size-top-up from the first committee.
Third order from a different department fest; one order upgraded to hoodie pack.

key_assumptions: Fest committees pay ₹340 per 180 GSM tee and ₹690 per 300 GSM hoodie in 100+ bulk, matching local printer retail quotes near campus.

Partner printer bulk rate is ₹240 per tee and ₹520 per hoodie; delivery cost per customer = ₹26,000 goods (blended mix) + ₹500 campus delivery + ₹1,000 proof/coordination time = ₹27,500, giving ~40% gross margin on the tee pack.
One paying customer = one bulk order per month; avg ₹46,000 blends T-shirt pack, hoodie pack and occasional rush add-on.
Founder contributes ₹15,000 of personal savings; burn stays ₹2,000/month because all tools are free tiers and printing is paid from customer advances, not capital.

channels.name: Campus club WhatsApp groups + Instagram DMs
channels.tactic: Post 1 photo of sample tee/hoodie with per-piece price in 7 named college club/fest WhatsApp groups, then DM 20 club heads and fest convenors per day on Instagram for 30 days.

channels.name: Walk-in to fest committee notice boards + 3 local printer partnerships
channels.tactic: Visit 2 college departments and 1 fest committee room per week with 5 printed sample tees, collect 10 contact numbers per visit for WhatsApp follow-up.

first_10_customers: List 10 clubs and fests in your own college with their heads' names and Instagram handles; DM each with the cold message and a photo of your sample tee.
Send the cold message to 40 club/fest heads across 2 neighbouring colleges via Instagram and WhatsApp for 5 days straight.
Offer 1 free sample T-shirt with the club's logo printed to the first 3 committee heads who reply, delivered by hand on campus.
Ask your batchmate who heads a club to place the first order as a pilot, paid via Razorpay 50% advance link.
Post the delivered order photo in 7 college WhatsApp groups and ask the club head to forward it to their committee WhatsApp groups.
Follow up every non-replying club head after 48 hours with a one-line message: 'Need 100+ tees for your fest? Quote in 2 hours.'
growth.cold_message: Hi [Name], I saw [Club/Fest] is ordering tees for [event] — I print 180 GSM custom tees at ₹340/piece for 100+ units with a digital proof before you pay. Free sample tee with your logo printed, delivered on campus this week. Want the quote?

objections.objection: We already have a local printer we use every year.
objections.response: Send me their quote — I'll beat it per piece and give you a written delivery date plus a print proof before you pay 50% advance, no risk if you don't like it.

objections.objection: We can't pay advance before seeing the final output.
objections.response: I'll print and deliver 1 free sample tee with your logo first; you pay the 50% Razorpay advance only after you approve the sample and digital proof.

critic.verdict: The plan is a coherent, low-risk campus-first physical merch business with realistic pricing, free tools, and a clear path to a first bulk order. The strategy, build, and growth sections all describe the same customer (fest committees) buying the same product (bulk custom tees/hoodies) through the same channels (WhatsApp/Instagram). Main soft spots are delivery-cost realism, aggressive day-30 revenue targets for a student with no track record, and a slightly thin growth playbook.
critic.biggest_risk: A student founder with no portfolio closing a ₹34,000–₹69,000 bulk order within 30 days from a cold Instagram DM is optimistic; committees typically pick printers with visible past work and existing relationships, so the first order may slip well past day 30 and test the founder's runway and motivation.
